meta.description: Downloads the BLT laser head selection guide PDF, extracts all text per page (saved as JSON), and extracts all embedded images as PNG files. Set WAVLON_ASSETS_PATH environment variable to the absolute path of your wavlon-lasers-website/assets folder.
meta.usage: 1. Import this workflow into n8n. 2. Set WAVLON_ASSETS_PATH env var to your assets folder path. 3. Install canvas and pdf2json npm packages in your n8n environment. 4. Click Execute Workflow.
